message: Sensex rises 1.5% as IT and auto stocks rally on strong Q2 earnings.
Tesla shares jump 7% after strong delivery numbers beat forecasts.
Pharma sector sees profit booking as investors shift to FMCG.
Small-cap stocks outperform large-caps for the third week in a row.
Investors brace for volatility ahead of US Fed interest rate decision.
Adani Group stocks rebound after clarifications on debt exposure.
Tech sector stocks fall after disappointing results from major software firm.
Goldman Sachs revises India’s 2026 GDP forecast upward to 7.2%.
Nifty Bank index hits all-time high amid strong credit growth.
Foreign investors pour ₹8,000 crore into Indian markets this month.
